description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache' that manages caching mechanisms for HTML Definition objects within the HTMLPurifier library, including methods for generating cache keys, validating cache entries, and abstract methods for cache operations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache
classes.description: Abstract class providing core cache management methods for HTML definition objects, implementing a factory pattern and defining abstract methods for cache operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a specific definition type.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a unique cache key based on configuration.

methods.name: isOld
methods.description: Determines if a cache key is outdated with respect to current configuration.

methods.name: checkDefType
methods.description: Verifies that a definition's type matches the cache's type.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Abstract method to add a definition to the cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Abstract method to save a definition unconditionally.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Abstract method to replace an existing cache entry.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a definition from cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a cache entry.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Abstract method to clear all cache entries.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Abstract method to remove expired cache entries.
